One member is different by –CH2 group. Which has the molecular mass of 14 amu. So, a regular series of organic compounds having the same functional group and mass difference is 14 amu from one compound to consecutive another compound is called homologous series. The individual member of a homologous series is called a homologue and the phenomenon is called homology.
